title: Non-Euclidean Map Authoring
selected_by_owner: Owner issued Continue in the established MMHT Map Maker conversation after completion of Cycle 13, directing the planned Cycle 14 on 2026-11-20.

in_scope: Add typed semantic-space roles and portal anchors to existing geometry without changing stable map feature IDs; allow pointer or keyboard-coordinate anchor creation.
Author explicit connections, cross-level and cross-map non-Euclidean links, structural containment/nesting/stacking, direction, arrival rotation/reflection, source metadata and visibility.
Preview confirmed directional graph reachability without deriving topological truth from Euclidean geometry and without executing traversal or reality changes.

Deliver distinct Carnival, Brinegate and Lantern Post editable samples, self-contained HTML, role-filtered GM/player map references, diagnostics and browser file round-trip evidence, preserving prior map cycles.
boundaries: Authoring and map projection only. Transition/Portal/Reality, movement/navigation and permission owners retain gameplay and validation authority; route previews do not authorize travel.
Non-Euclidean diagram display frames do not define physical scale. Containment, nesting and stacking never become traversable edges by implication.
No installed Unity or physical Android/Windows, online synchronization, live provider boundary, AI/canonical publishing or owner review acceptance is certified.

evidence.sample_artifacts: Cycle14 ZIP contains three editable drafts and three GM/player map reference pairs plus README, test report, handoff, screenshot, index and SHA256 manifest.
evidence.validation: Embedded JavaScript syntax passed Node --check. Chromium Playwright set_content loaded standalone HTML; all three examples passed documentError and non-Euclidean diagnostics, with no page errors. Player projections suppressed GM-only endpoint IDs/geometry/notes/links. Directional trace tests proved one-way folded passages, non-navigable nesting and Lantern-to-Carnival cross-map linkage without reverse connectivity. UI link edit/create/delete and existing-geometry role adopt/remove passed. Browser UI exported editable and player JSON; reimport of a diverged same-ID draft produced a distinct map with correctly remapped internal link endpoints. Broken targets persisted in GM diagnostics and disappeared from player link export. Pointer and keyboard-coordinate anchor creation passed. Previously delivered three Cycle12 logistics and three Cycle13 habitat-land-use examples were accessible. The editor remained horizontally usable at 390px. No installed-app or physical-device proof.
source_references: Cycle12.zip, Cycle13 standalone artifacts as delivered in conversation
Project/Feature/UI/Screen reference Bibles (enduring design, not operations authority)

next_action: Owner reviews Cycle14 standalone non-Euclidean editor and sample exports; begin MMHT-15 Advanced Spatial Geometry & Round-Trip only upon further owner direction.
successor_rule: Requires owner direction to start the next standalone HTML review cycle.

last_material_progress.evidence: MMHT-14 standalone HTML, three editable maps, role-filtered references, topological route preview regression, browser import/export and responsive Chromium tests.

stop_reason.evidence: Bounded standalone MMHT-14 browser artifact delivered, exported and validated. Gameplay systems and installed-client acceptance remain outside scope.
